data: Is the LM-Backend box to the right of the UPR-Frontend box?

The LM-Backend box is positioned to the right of the UPR-Frontend box in the figure. The UPR-Frontend box is on the left side of the figure, while the LM-Backend box is on the right side. Therefore, the answer is yes, the LM-Backend box is to the right of the UPR-Frontend box.
